line: There's a flaw in AI narration, and you can't say what it is.
One word loses its ending. An S goes dull, or too hot.
voice_doctor.py measures pacing, rate, sibilance, and endings, straight from the audio.
It grades every line against this narration's own median, not a guess.
One bad overlap, and the check fails the whole file.
--repair levels every line to the median, pulls a harsh S back in, and checks itself again until nothing's left.
Never ship AI narration without the check that catches what you can't.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for setups that actually works.
